purpose: Distinguish whether the pinned model can describe the frozen request/plan/report meanings in a small prose task. This is not an alternative extraction contract.
intervention: speaker and exact original text only; no provenance packet
existing grounded numeric sampler with grammar removed
no native claim binding or publication authority
fixed: all seven original strings, speakers and original semantic labels
seed 42 and existing grounded numeric parameters
evaluation: Review every output for activity type, performer, action meaning, lack of invented time/outcome and policy/question rejection. Retain every failed/missing/ambiguous response. Positive prose alone does not satisfy source binding or full compiler acceptance.
causalLimit: Prompt, payload and grammar differ together. This diagnostic cannot attribute a difference to one component or claim reproducibility from one call.
